verdict.rationale: Steel is an API-first product ("open-source browser API"). Its docs cover API endpoints for sessions, captchas, credentials, files and agent traces, and a live OpenAPI spec plus an official CLI expose the same session workflows programmatically. Even UI-oriented features like agent trace timelines and exports have a dedicated Agent Traces API. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of API/UI parity, evidence that account-level dashboard functions (API keys, billing, team settings) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
